    • getOutput

      String getOutput(Content container, Map params, String body, ContentProcessingOptions options) throws ContentProcessorException
      Execute command and get content as an string
      Parameters:
      container - The parent element where this command was inserted
      params - Runtime parameters, set for every specificc invocation of the command
      body - If the command has a body, it will be supplied here
      options - Processing options that will be passed from the parent context
      Returns:
      Content as a String
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If anything goes really wrong with the translation. Normally syntax problems, etc, will just display the error as result content.
